content: Anjali Desai from First Guard Brokers called Akanksha Bhatt to discuss the upcoming renewal of her home policy (#H-4521, expiring 30/10/2026) and offer bundled motor insurance options. Ms. Bhatt inquired about Plan A and Plan B motor options, discussed deductibles, and applied a No Claim Bonus for an additional 5% discount. Ultimately, Ms. Bhatt selected Plan A with monthly installment payments of ₹1,225 (totaling approximately ₹14,700 yearly), and the agent agreed to send the updated quote and confirmation email.

action_items: Set up monthly installment payment plan
